critical_findings.title: Rule state transitions leave no audit record
critical_findings.detail: ['APPROVE', 'PUBLISH'] completed against a clean database without writing an audit event. docs/PRODUCT_SPEC.md safety rule 5 requires every state transition to create one.
critical_findings.root_cause_hint: the review and publication paths in rule_store write rule state directly; only the API layer writes audit events, so any call that does not go through it leaves no trail

critical_findings.title: ACCEPTED_VALUES on payment_type admits the value it must reject
critical_findings.detail: 7 archived proposal(s) put ['Invalid Payment (Dispute/Test)'] inside the allow-list. docs/SUPABASE_DATASET_CONTRACT.md#representation-policy states that literal is deliberately outside the governed set so the agent can surface the 4 known invalid rows. Scope: the agent path (Run 1, rule_proposer_node). The dashboard path builds the same rule type from policy.governed_value_sets and is not implicated.
critical_findings.root_cause_hint: rule_proposer_node builds the enum from the values observed in the column being validated, so every defect present at profiling time is admitted into its own allow-list and the rule can never fire

critical_findings.title: Golden case GC-SCOPE-NO-RULES-ON-INTERNAL-COLUMNS failed
critical_findings.detail: Even on a legitimate table, columns the platform owns are not data-quality subjects. A UNIQUE rule on run_id measures the platform's own id generator. | observed: rule_not_on_columns: 2 violation(s): ['proposal_runs.run_id', 'proposal_runs.status']

critical_findings.title: Golden case GC-E3-ENUM-FROM-POLICY failed
critical_findings.detail: The payment-type allow-list must come from the governed policy, not from the values observed in the column. The contract deliberately places one literal outside the governed set so the agent can surface the four known invalid rows; admitting that literal makes the rule unable to fire. | observed: enum_from_policy: 7/8 proposal(s) admit an excluded value; min_violations: best run flagged 2, required 4
critical_findings.root_cause_hint: expectation recorded in docs/SUPABASE_DATASET_CONTRACT.md#representation-policy

critical_findings.title: Golden case GC-E5-UNIQUE-ON-BUSINESS-KEY failed
critical_findings.detail: Duplicate detection must target the business fingerprint. A UNIQUE rule placed on the surrogate key source_row_id is vacuously true by construction, because that column is generated to be unique even when the business rows it points at are duplicates. This case is expected to FAIL today; it states the requirement, not the current behaviour. | observed: rule_not_on_columns: 4 violation(s): ['source_rows.source_row_id']
critical_findings.root_cause_hint: expectation recorded in eval/results/E1_E5_EVALUATION.md#E5

critical_findings.title: Golden case GL-REASONING-MUST-CITE-FIGURES failed
critical_findings.detail: A rationale with no number in it cannot have been derived from the profile. The check is weak on purpose -- it proves citation happened, not that the figure is correct -- but a rule whose reasoning contains no figure at all is a rule the steward has no basis to approve. | observed: must_cite_numbers: 30/383 rationale(s) cite no figure at all
critical_findings.root_cause_hint: expectation recorded in src/agents/nodes/templates.py#_RULE_PROPOSER_USER

critical_findings.title: ACCEPTED_VALUES rules are structurally unable to fail
critical_findings.detail: 66/74 (89.2%) of ACCEPTED_VALUES rules cannot report a violation on the data they guard. Example: source_rows.vendor_id.ACCEPTED_VALUES -- allow-list of 5 covers all 5 observed values, so no row can violate it
critical_findings.root_cause_hint: the parameter is derived from the same column the rule validates, so every value present at profiling time is admitted by the rule itself; this is measurable without any ground truth and applies to any dataset

critical_findings.title: Ingestion converts unparseable values into indistinguishable nulls
critical_findings.detail: 8/8 malformed inputs were accepted without a signal. Examples: to_float('12,50') -> None, to_int('N/A') -> None, to_float('1e999') -> inf, to_float('nan') -> nan
critical_findings.root_cause_hint: src/worker.py to_float/to_int catch every exception and return None, so a conversion failure is stored as an empty cell; profiling later measures the resulting null rate as if it came from the source

critical_findings.title: Recall = 0 on defect class INVALID_CATEGORY (dataset-nyc-yellow-taxi-50k)
critical_findings.detail: 250 true defects of class INVALID_CATEGORY went undetected. Expected rule types: ['ACCEPTED_VALUES'].

critical_findings.title: Recall = 0 on defect class DUPLICATE_ROW (dataset-nyc-yellow-taxi-50k)
